newer_changes_search: Web search for 2025-2026 changes to MSJE/MoTA post-matric scholarships found only a reported (not notified) plan to raise the SC income limit to Rs 4.5 lakh; nothing specific to the ST scheme (no revised income limit, amounts, renaming or discontinuation). The MoTA page snapshot (2026-10-25) still describes the scheme with the Rs 2.5 lakh limit and reports releases up to 31 Mar 2025 and annexures through 2025-26.

findings.note: The quote ('... disbursement of scholarship to eligible ST students directly to their bank accounts through DBT') only indirectly supports 'must be ST'; the text also appears in the pre-matric section. The page title and context (scholarship schemes for ST students) make the meaning clear.
findings.suggestion: When the MoTA post-matric guideline PDF is added, quote its eligibility clause for Scheduled Tribes and raise the rules to 'confirmed'.

findings.note: Maintenance Rs 230 to Rs 1,200 per month and fees up to the state limit match the MoTA page exactly. These are long-standing rates; the page may lag the current guideline.
findings.suggestion: Cross-check amounts against the current guideline PDF linked on the same page.

findings.note: The MoTA page snapshot lists no documents (only an Aadhaar notification link and DBT to bank accounts). caste_certificate, income_certificate, marksheet are plausible but not supported by the cited source.
findings.suggestion: Cite the guideline PDF or an NSP document list for the documents.
